title: Website Security Charge Counted Before a Domain Retry
content:
> Harborline Customer Accounts, for the customer's Website Security plan

## Rule

The security plan the top-up counts is the customer's active site security plan with auto-renew on when its next auto-renew attempt falls before the retry; a security plan has no retry days, so its single attempt day is the security charter's renewal day before its term end. Because every auto-renew charge in any category tries credit first, the top-up covers this charge in full when its next auto-renew attempt falls from today up to the day before the retry, which credit would otherwise pay first. It is priced for its billing term at its annual price for a 12-month term or its monthly price for a 1-month term. The security plan charge of the top-up follows where the site runs: a site whose security plan names an active Harborline hosting plan on Web Hosting Plans is charged that price reduced by the higher of the product's hosted-site discount and the account tier's security discount, the two never added; a site hosted elsewhere is charged that price reduced by the account tier's security discount alone; in either case the discount is the price less the reduced price rounded half up to the cent; and otherwise no security plan charge is counted. The charge so found enters the credit the retry needs.

## Positive and negative cases (hypothetical)

| Security plan | Site runs on | Discount applied |
|---|---|---|
| counted, annual price $119.00 | an active Harborline hosting plan, hosted-site discount 12 percent, tier discount 10 percent | 12 percent: $104.72 |
| counted, annual price $119.00 | a host elsewhere, tier discount 10 percent | 10 percent: $107.10 |
| not due before the retry | either | no charge |
